assay: Ion Proton total RNA-seq (globin-depleted) of blood leukocytes; Tophat2/bowtie2 to hg19; Cuffquant + Cuffnorm normalized FPKM (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1)
sample_inclusion: Group 1 only: 21 PD patients (10 tai chi, 11 MET), each sampled before and 48-72 h after a 12-week exercise program = 42 RNA-seq samples (S3.1.p1, S3.3.p1). Group 2 (19 patients) is qPCR/immunoassay validation only, not in GEO.
primary_estimand: Within-patient change in leukocyte gene expression after 12 weeks of exercise (after vs before), tai chi and MET pooled (S3.3.p1: exercise type gave no transcriptomic difference, so groups combined)
planned_contrasts: time after vs before, paired by patient, both exercise types pooled (S2.4.p1, S3.3.p1; paper: 1,873 DEGs, 417 higher after, 1,453 higher before)
paper_method: paired Student t-test on Cuffnorm FPKM, before vs after (S2.4.p1); scale of the tested values (linear or log) not stated
paper_results: 1,873 DEGs (S3.3.p1; 1,453 + 417 = 1,870, internal mismatch of 3). Down after: ODC1 (most down), CD3E, GRAP2, FOS, ZAP70, IL2RA/B, TNFRSF18, RTP5, CCL5, CD28; up after: TRAF3, TNF, AGAP2 (S3.3.p2-p3, S3.4.p1-p3, S3.5.p2). KEGG: TCR signaling down, osteoclast differentiation up (S3.4.p1).
